description: The official Skill Base CLI client. Use the `skb` (Skill Base CLI) command to search, install (single skill or collection), update, delete, publish, and import-from-GitHub skills from Skill Base, as well as configure skb. Triggered when users say "publish skill to skill base", "install collection", "import skill from github", "download/update/delete skill from skill base", "configure skb", "am I logged in", "check skb login", or "configure skill-base-cli".
